218544.title: Rudraprayag
218544.extract:
Rudraprayag (रुद्रप्रयाग Rudraprayāg) is the town in upper Garhwal where the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers meet. It's also home to the Rudranath Temple, one of the holy Panch Kedār sites.
